name: NixOS
description: NixOS is a declarative, reproducible Linux distribution built on the Nix package manager, stewarded by the NixOS Foundation in the Netherlands. Its entire system configuration is expressed in Nix, enabling atomic upgrades, rollbacks, and reproducible environments a foundational tool for infrastructure-as-code.

owner.name: NixOS Foundation
owner.description: Dutch non-profit foundation governing the NixOS Linux distribution and Nix package manager.
